author: MiYu
scope: Tracked Frostbound .mmat/.mat sidecar completeness, stable generated IDs, unique material IDs and source provenance. No material/model/texture payload changed.
rootCause: Generated seasonal/placement materials were written without sidecars; six importers copied material sidecars to new asset paths without remapping their GUIDs. Missing GUID sidecars are generated by the editor during asset registration.
identityPolicy: Existing canonical WarcraftIII IDs are preserved. Missing material sidecars and independent material copies use UUID5(URL, mengine/frostbound-realms/ + asset path). Existing nonduplicate sidecars remain unchanged.

referenceAudit.scope: Independent read-only audit of scene/prefab/json/material/JS/C# and effect/instance/shader consumers; path-based material resolution confirmed.

otherComputer.scope: Other checkout HEAD and representative .mat.meta paths were requested; its exact additional files are not yet verified.
